description: Road accidents with casualties in Israel, 2017-2022 (CBS abbreviated public-use files) is a series of data sets listed in data.gov.il, an open data portal, published or maintained by Central Bureau of Statistics. Coverage: Israel. The portal lists 6 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its title on the portal is "תאונות דרכים עם נפגעים - 2019 - PUF מקוצר" (Hebrew). The portal files it under the publisher Central Bureau of Statistics. Its tags are נתוני הלמס, תאונות דרכים, תחבורה. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2024-09-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-il-portal.
